pieces.name: Wide Bridge Corner

pieces.name: Wide Ramp 1 : 4

pieces.name: Wide Wall Corner

pieces.name: Wide Doorway
pieces.notes: Clear opening 4 m wide by 2.5 m high; no collision across opening.

pieces.name: Wide Window Wall
pieces.notes: Open aperture 4 m wide, from Z=1 m to Z=2.5 m; no glass or collision in aperture.

pieces.name: Wide Stairs
pieces.notes: Eight 0.25 m rises and 1 m treads; low end -Y. Collision follows the visible steps.

pieces.name: Wide Glass Wall
pieces.notes: Solid non-breakable glass pane; seven-metre view between structural jambs. Stacks with 3 m walls.

pieces.name: Wide Glazed Window
pieces.notes: Existing window frame with a solid non-breakable glass pane in its 4 by 1.5 m opening.

pieces.name: Wide Tall Doorway
pieces.notes: Clear opening 4 m wide by 3.5 m high. No threshold or collision in the throat.

pieces.name: Wide Vehicle Doorway
pieces.notes: Clear opening 8 m wide by 5.5 m high. No threshold or collision in the throat.

pieces.name: Wide Ramp 8 m / Rise 2 m
pieces.notes: Low end -Y, high end +Y; zero-height nose, exact 2 m rise over 8 m run (1:4).

pieces.name: Wide Ramp 4 m / Rise 4 m
pieces.notes: Low end -Y, high end +Y; zero-height nose, exact 4 m rise over 16 m run (1:4).

pieces.name: Wide Ramp 8 m / Rise 4 m
pieces.notes: Low end -Y, high end +Y; zero-height nose, exact 4 m rise over 16 m run (1:4).

pieces.name: Wide Ramp 8 m / Gentle Rise 2 m
pieces.notes: Low end -Y, high end +Y; zero-height nose, exact 2 m rise over 16 m run (1:8).

pieces.name: Wide Guarded Landing
pieces.notes: Deck top 0.5 m; 1.5 m solid side rails. Open +/-Y mouths with 7 m clear width; no overhead obstruction.

pieces.name: Wide Bridge T Junction
pieces.notes: 4 m paths. Side mouth centres (-6,4) and (6,4); stem mouth (0,-6). Empty lower corners remain open.

pieces.name: Wide Bridge Cross Junction
pieces.notes: 4 m paths with mouth centres (+/-6,0) and (0,+/-6). Four corner quadrants remain open.

pieces.name: Wide Bridge Corner 8 m
pieces.notes: 8 m-wide L-shaped deck; the +X/+Y quadrant stays open.

pieces.name: Wide Lift Station
pieces.notes: Central 4 by 4 m deck at 0.5 m with four 4 m-wide, 2 m-long 1:4 walk-up ramps from ground level. Corner housings are 1.5 m tall; eight metres of central overhead clearance.

pieces.name: Wide Teleporter Housing
pieces.notes: Clear opening 4 m wide by 3.5 m high. No threshold or collision in the throat. Green field is visual-only, UV-mapped and two-sided; gameplay teleporting uses paired markers.

pieces.name: Wide Glass Corner
pieces.notes: L-shaped glazed wall on -X/-Y edges, opening toward +X/+Y; solid non-breakable panes.

pieces.name: Wide Door Panel
pieces.notes: Separate solid lift-up panel matching the doorway opening. Place 0.75 m toward local -Y from its frame to slide clear of the lintel.

pieces.name: Wide Vehicle Door Panel
pieces.notes: Separate solid lift-up panel matching the doorway opening. Place 0.75 m toward local -Y from its frame to slide clear of the lintel.

pieces.name: Wide Teleporter Pad
pieces.notes: Solid 0.5 m deck; green inset surface is visual-only. Pair with separate gameplay teleport markers.
